newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No EU 97/98 grain tenders before end June - Fischler.
newsitem.headline: No EU 97/98 grain tenders before end June - Fischler.

text.p: European Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Monday that the EU's wheat export tax was likely to continue for the moment because world prices remain high.
He also told reporters after addressing an EU farm conference that the EU's 1997/1998 grain export tenders would not be announced before the end of June.

"We use it as a flexible instrument. It depends on world market prices. If they are too high, we will continue to use the export tax," he said after talking to the conference organised by the European Parliament.
Asked if wheat prices were too high, Fishler said: "I would not say too high but high."
Regarding the start of the 1997/1998 grain export tenders, he said: "I see no reason to change. We will start as in the last years."
Before tenders are announced, EU farm ministers must first agree the 1997/1998 (July/June) farm price package, which they are due to complete at their meeting in Luxembourg from June 22 to 25.
